info.title: EU VIES VAT Number Validator & Reverse Charge Tax Auditor
info.description:
Validates European Union & Northern Ireland (XI) corporate VAT numbers in real time via the official EU Commission VIES REST API and local regex checksums. Audits Intra-EU Reverse Charge eligibility and generates Markdown compliance certificates.

### Enterprise B2B Value Proposition (EU VIES VAT Number Validator & Reverse Charge Tax Auditor)
- **Target B2B Buyers:** European B2B SaaS Billing Engines, Cross-Border Marketplaces, and ERP Tax Compliance Modules.
- **Zero External API Keys Required:** Connects directly to authoritative government, regulatory, and financial primary registries with built-in retry/backoff and deterministic schema normalization.
- **Quantitative Scoring & RAG Briefs:** Every record is enriched with a quantitative 0-100 risk/viability score and an LLM-ready Markdown executive brief (`EU VIES VAT & Reverse Charge Audited`).
- **Backend Proxy Secret Injection:** RapidAPI Studio and Zyla API Hub inject `Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_API_TOKEN>` invisibly at the proxy layer when forwarding synchronous calls to `https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/b2b-quant-apis~eu-vies-vat-tax-compliance-auditor/run-sync-get-dataset-items`.
- **Marketplace Categories:** RapidAPI `Finance` | Zyla API Hub `Taxes & Compliance`.
- **Subscription Tiers (USD):** `BASIC` ($0.00/mo, 15 req/mo hard cap), `PRO` ($19.00/mo, 1,000 req/mo + $0.02/extra), `ULTRA` ($49.00/mo, 5,000 req/mo + $0.015/extra), `MEGA` ($149.00/mo, 25,000 req/mo + $0.010/extra).
- **SEO Keywords:** eu-vat-validation, vies-api, reverse-charge, cross-border-tax, european-kyb, vat-compliance, b2b-invoicing.

EuViesVatTaxComplianceAuditorRequest.title: EU VIES VAT Number Validator & Reverse Charge Tax Auditor Request Schema
EuViesVatTaxComplianceAuditorRequest.description: Provide one or more European Union (27 Member States + XI Northern Ireland) VAT identification numbers to validate syntax, active VIES registration, trader legal name/address, and Intra-EU Reverse Charge eligibility.

vatNumbers.title: EU VAT Numbers (Comma or Line Separated)
vatNumbers.description: Comma, space, or newline-separated EU VAT numbers including 2-letter country prefix (e.g., 'IE6388047V, DE811128135, FR40303265045').

requesterCountryCode.title: Seller / Requester EU Country Code
requesterCountryCode.description: 2-letter EU country code of the invoicing entity (e.g., 'DE', 'NL', 'FR', 'IE') to determine Cross-Border B2B Reverse Charge (0% VAT) vs. Domestic VAT.

maxResults.title: Maximum VAT Numbers to Audit
maxResults.description: Maximum number of VAT records to audit in a single batch (1 to 200).

EuViesVatTaxComplianceAuditorRecord.title: EU VIES VAT Number Validator & Reverse Charge Tax Auditor Output Record
EuViesVatTaxComplianceAuditorRecord.description: Enriched B2B dataset item returned by `eu-vies-vat-tax-compliance-auditor`.

fullVatNumber.title: Full VAT Number
fullVatNumber.description: Normalized EU VAT identifier including Member State prefix.

countryCode.title: Member State Code
countryCode.description: 2-letter EU VIES jurisdiction code (AT, BE, DE, EL, ES, FR, IE, IT, NL, XI, etc.).

vatNumber.title: National VAT Number
vatNumber.description: National numeric/alphanumeric VAT digits without country prefix.

syntaxValid.title: Syntax Valid
syntaxValid.description: Whether the VAT number matches the official Member State structural regex.

viesActive.title: VIES Active Registration
viesActive.description: Whether the VAT number is actively registered for Intra-EU cross-border transactions.

traderName.title: Registered Trader Name
traderName.description: Legal company name returned by the European Commission VIES registry.

traderAddress.title: Registered Address
traderAddress.description: Official corporate address on file in the Member State tax registry.

reverseChargeStatus.title: Reverse Charge Eligibility
reverseChargeStatus.description: Tax invoicing determination (ELIGIBLE_INTRA_EU_0_VAT, DOMESTIC_STANDARD_VAT, or DO_NOT_ZERO_RATE).

complianceRiskScore.title: Compliance Risk Score (0-100)
complianceRiskScore.description: Quantitative tax audit risk score (0 = lowest risk/verified active, 100 = invalid/high risk).

markdownVatCertificate.title: Markdown Tax Compliance Certificate
markdownVatCertificate.description: Audit-ready Markdown VAT compliance certificate for ERP/Finance attachment.

quantScore.title: Quantitative Compliance & Opportunity Score (0-100)
quantScore.description: Normalized deterministic score from 0 to 100 generated by the quantitative engine.

ragMarkdownBrief.title: Executive RAG Markdown Brief
ragMarkdownBrief.description: LLM-ready executive summary formatted in Markdown for RAG pipelines and compliance dossiers.
